sections.heading: How to Play Unholy
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Unholy"][color=c6]Unholy Death Knight Rotation in Midnight Season 1[/color][/h2]
Unholy Death Knight primarily operates based on resources and current procs. This generally means that what we do at any given moment will be based on both of these factors, which makes a typical rotation out of the question, and instead operates on a priority list. 

[center]
[wrapper width=80%]
[box border=true]
[center][table]
[tr][td]
[table]
[tr]
[td][icon name=artifactability_unholydeathknight_deathsembrace size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
[td][b]Keep Abilities on Cooldown:[/b] Unholy is a very burst-focused specialization, which relies incredibly heavily on using its cooldowns as often as possible to maximize its damage. This makes cooldown setup and execution its highest priority.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
[tr]
[td][icon name=spell_shadow_painspike size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
[td][b]Spend your Sudden Doom procs ASAP:[/b] Sudden Doom has many interactions with Unholy talents, while also being the strongest non-cooldown button we can press in any scenario. This makes spending this proc with [spell=47541] or [spell=207317]  as quickly as possible one of the best things you can do. [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
[tr][td][icon name=inv_ghoulnorthrend size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
[td][b]Keep an eye on your Ghouls:[/b] Lesser Ghouls are the bread and butter of Unholy Death Knights in Midnight. So, making sure that you always have stacks of [spell=1254252] from [spell=85948] to allow [spell=55090] to summon them is vital. [/td][/tr][/table]
[/td][/tr][/table][/center]
[/box]
[/wrapper]
[/center]
[pad]
[center][cta-button=guide=32729 icon=spell_deathknight_unholypresence]Unholy Death Knight Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Rotation Priority
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="Rotation Priority"][icon name=spell_deathknight_unholypresence type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon][color=c6] Best Unholy Death Knight Rotation[/color][/h2]
Unholy Death Knights' rotational priorities are more often than not, focused on resource management. Between Runes, Runic Power, and our Lesser Ghoul stacks, Unholy has a plethora of resources to manage, and doing so well will drastically improve your DPS.

For all forms of content, Unholy follows a priority list of what spells to cast. Below, we break down the main priority lists for Unholy Death Knights: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and your opener sequence.

[wrapper][center][box border=true]
[h3 type=bar toc=false]Hero Talent Master Switches[/h3]
[pad]
You can use the master switches below to flip the [b][i]entire page's[/i][/b] options to your selected choice. 
[pad]
[center][b]The Current setting is [span display-options=rider] [symbol=wow-hero-talent-rider-of-the-apocalypse] [color=#5AFFA2]Rider of the Apocalypse[/color][/span][span display-options=san] [symbol=wow-hero-talent-sanlayn] [color=#CE655E]San'layn[/color][/span][/b][/center][center]
[wrapper width=520px]
[grid column-width=210px]
[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=inv_ability_rideroftheapocalypsedeathknight_apocalypsenow enable-options="scythe,army,sr,reaping,rider,garg" color=#5AFFA2]Rider of the Apocalypse[/display-group]
[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=inv_ability_sanlayndeathknight_vampiricstrike enable-options="scythe,army,sr,reaping,san,garg" color=#CE655E]Sanlayn[/display-group]
[/grid]
[/wrapper]
[/center]
[/box][/center][/wrapper]
[br]

[wrapper width=85%]
[/center]
[tabs name="Rotations" uniform=true]
[tab name="Single-Target Priority" icon=spell_holy_divinespirit]
[h3 toc="Single Target Priority" type=bar] [color=death-knight] Best Unholy Death Knight Single Target Rotation[/color][/h3]
[pad]
Unholy in Single Target plays around a priority list, juggling both ability cooldowns and resources based on an order of power. This means with each GCD we go top to bottom on a list, and press the button with the current highest value.

[center][wrapper width=70%][center]
[minor-heading type=bar toc=false][color=death-knight]Priority outside of Forbidden Knowledge[/color][/minor-heading]
[ol]
[li display-options=!bb&!pest]Cast [spell=77575] if [spell=191587] is not active.[/li]
[li display-options=san]Cast [spell=85948] before [spell=1233448] if you have 3 or fewer [spell=1254252] stacks.[/li]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=death-knight][icon name=spell_deathknight_armyofthedead type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon] Unholy Death Knight Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]

Unholy has a few major cooldowns with mechanics that may make you want to use them at specific times. Below, there's a section to go over each of these, explaining when and why you should use them when you do.

[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Army of the Dead" icon=spell_deathknight_armyofthedead]
[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=death-knight] Army of the Dead\u200e [/color][/h3]
[spell=42650] is our biggest cooldown and serves as a trigger for many other talents. The most prominent among those would be [spell=1242608], [spell=1242147], and [spell=444040], where this ability will summon additional pets to fight for us.

With the sheer quantity of pets being summoned by this ability, if you have talented [spell=390259], it's [b]vital[/b] to ensure that [spell=42650] and [spell=1233448] stay in sync, so you are using both at the same time. Generally, this will mean ensuring you hit [spell=1233448] as soon as possible after it comes off cooldown once between every [spell=42650] cast.
[pad]
[/tab]
[tab name="Dark Transformation" icon=achievement_boss_festergutrotface]
[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=death-knight] Dark Transformation\u200e [/color][/h3]
Similar to Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation also triggers several other talents. The most important among these are [spell=390259], [spell=1241705], and [spell=1265959]. 

With Commander of the Dead, it is particularly important to keep your cooldowns synchronized. With Dark Transformation being an off-global cooldown ability, you can safely macro this into Army of the Dead and only have to worry about a single use between each Army window. 

In addition to this, if you talent Outnumber, it becomes incredibly important to try to time your Dark Transformation with add spawns, as the Lesser Ghoul [spell=1278150] attacks are incredibly potent, and will constitute a major portion of our AoE damage potential. 
[pad]
[/tab]
[tab name="Putrefy" icon=inv12_ability_deathknight_putrefy]
[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=death-knight] Putrefy\u200e [/color][/h3]
[spell=1247378] is a fairly unique ability in how it should be used. With other talents allowing you to trigger Putrefy, some of which even use the charges you have for you. This is usually a short-duration cooldown, averaging about 15 seconds between uses, making it fairly rotational. 

The major talents to consider for when to use Putrefy are [spell=343294] (in addition to [spell=377514]).  

Now, there is a pair of talents that can throw a wrench into this logic with [spell=343294] and [spell=377514]. Due to Soul Reaper consuming 2 of your current Putrefy charges, it can be worth not pressing Putrefy if Soul Reaper will be available to use in the next 15 seconds or so. While your target is below 35% health, this will mean you never manually press Putrefy. 

Outside of this, if you talent Reaping, you should try to bank a charge for Dark Transformation windows to save you the global and rune you would have spent on Putrefy otherwise.
[pad]
[/tab]
[/tabs]

Our Unholy Death Knight guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on [b]View Changelog[/b] in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page. [h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Unholy"][color=c6]Unholy Death Knight Rotation in Midnight Season 1[/color][/h2]
Unholy Death Knight primarily operates based on resources and current procs. This generally means that what we do at any given moment will be based on both of these factors, which makes a typical rotation out of the question, and instead operates on a priority list.

[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=death-knight][icon name=spell_deathknight_armyofthedead type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon] Unholy Death Knight Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]

Unholy has a few major cooldowns with mechanics that may make you want to use them at specific times. Below, there's a section to go over each of these, explaining when and why you should use them when you do.

[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Army of the Dead" icon=spell_deathknight_armyofthedead]
[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=death-knight] Army of the Dead\u200e [/color][/h3]
[spell=42650] is our biggest cooldown and serves as a trigger for many other talents. The most prominent among those would be [spell=1242608], [spell=1242147], and [spell=444040], where this ability will summon additional pets to fight for us.

With the sheer quantity of pets being summoned by this ability, if you have talented [spell=390259], it's [b]vital[/b] to ensure that [spell=42650] and [spell=1233448] stay in sync, so you are using both at the same time. Generally, this will mean ensuring you hit [spell=1233448] as soon as possible after it comes off cooldown once between every [spell=42650] cast.
[pad]
[/tab]
[tab name="Dark Transformation" icon=achievement_boss_festergutrotface]
[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=death-knight] Dark Transformation\u200e [/color][/h3]
Similar to Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation also triggers several other talents. The most important among these are [spell=390259], [spell=1241705], and [spell=1265959]. 

With Commander of the Dead, it is particularly important to keep your cooldowns synchronized. With Dark Transformation being an off-global cooldown ability, you can safely macro this into Army of the Dead and only have to worry about a single use between each Army window. 

In addition to this, if you talent Outnumber, it becomes incredibly important to try to time your Dark Transformation with add spawns, as the Lesser Ghoul [spell=1278150] attacks are incredibly potent, and will constitute a major portion of our AoE damage potential. 
[pad]
[/tab]
[tab name="Putrefy" icon=inv12_ability_deathknight_putrefy]
[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=death-knight] Putrefy\u200e [/color][/h3]
[spell=1247378] is a fairly unique ability in how it should be used. With other talents allowing you to trigger Putrefy, some of which even use the charges you have for you. This is usually a short-duration cooldown, averaging about 15 seconds between uses, making it fairly rotational. 

The major talents to consider for when to use Putrefy are [spell=343294] (in addition to [spell=377514]).  

Now, there is a pair of talents that can throw a wrench into this logic with [spell=343294] and [spell=377514]. Due to Soul Reaper consuming 2 of your current Putrefy charges, it can be worth not pressing Putrefy if Soul Reaper will be available to use in the next 15 seconds or so. While your target is below 35% health, this will mean you never manually press Putrefy. 

Outside of this, if you talent Reaping, you should try to bank a charge for Dark Transformation windows to save you the global and rune you would have spent on Putrefy otherwise.
[pad]
